test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Out of the blue
solution:
The correct answer is **'Completely unexpected'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Out of the blue **is an idiom that means** without warning or unexpectedly.**

 
 
• **​Example - ***She messaged me **out of the blue.***
 
 
 
• So, **completely unexpected **is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 

8b
